quote: One task where LLMs are understudied is Semantic Overlap Summarization (SOS), where the goal is to summarize the common/overlapping information between two alternative narratives conveying similar information.

Semantic Overlap Summarization (SOS) is a task aimed at extracting and condensing shared information between two input documents... We conduct a comprehensive benchmarking study on how LLMs perform on the SOS task using 16 popular models.
